clauses.quote: All parties may be represented by counsel, produce witnesses, hear all testimony of the other party, cross-examine witnesses, and examine all documentary evidence.
clauses.notes: Compound predicates grant parallel procedural rights to both sides.

clauses.quote: Within twenty working days following the hearing, the hearing examiner will submit a recommended solution to the Board, with copies to the teacher, the Superintendent, district representative, and to the Association.
The Board will make a final disposition of the case within forty-five calendar days after receiving the hearing examiner's recommendation.
The decision of the Board will be submitted in writing to all parties
clauses.notes: Extracted as independent clause joined by 'and'.

clauses.quote: and will be binding upon all parties, provided the decision does not exceed Board authority as established in the law.
clauses.notes: Extracted as independent clause joined by 'and'.

clauses.quote: The above time limits regarding hearing dates and decisions may be extended by mutual agreement.
clauses.subject_text: The above time limits regarding hearing dates and decisions

clauses.quote: The costs of the hearing examiner and of preparing a hearing record (if any) will be shared equally by the Board and the Association.
clauses.subject_text: The costs of the hearing examiner and of preparing a hearing record (if any)

clauses.quote: the cost of the hearing examiner and of preparing a hearing record will be shared equally by the Board and the employee.
clauses.subject_text: the cost of the hearing examiner and of preparing a hearing record
clauses.notes: Applies cost-sharing when the employee is not an Association member.

clauses.quote: the final decision will include appropriate reinstatement of lost pay to the teacher involved.
clauses.notes: Omitted preceding conditional clause as dependent.

clauses.quote: record of the District's attempt to dismiss the teacher will not become part of the teacher's personnel file.
clauses.subject_text: record of the District's attempt to dismiss the teacher
clauses.notes: Omitted preceding conditional clause as dependent.

clauses.quote: Material will be removed from the teacher's file when a teacher's claim that it is inaccurate has been sustained in dismissal proceedings.
Nothing herein shall be construed to limit the right of a teacher to appeal the District's decision to an appropriate court of law.
The reduction in force process will not apply
clauses.notes: Extracted as independent clause joined by 'and'.

clauses.quote: and need not be followed unless there is a district-wide reduction in force.
clauses.notes: Extracted as independent clause joined by 'and'.

clauses.quote: the Superintendent may release as many teachers as necessary.
